questions.question: Choose the option which does not represents color blindness

explanations.a: Monochromatic vision is seeing everything in black and white. It is not a type of color blindness.
explanations.b: Deuteranopia affects the ability to see green colors.
explanations.c: Tritanopia affects the ability to see blue colors.
explanations.d: Protanopia affects the ability to see red colors.

questions.question: Does this image represent color blindness?
If a person cannot tell red from green, what type of color blindness do they most likely have?

explanations.a: Correct. Protanopia and Deuteranopia affect red and green perception.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Monochromatic vision is not common in color blindness.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Red-green color blindness is very common.
